player_prompt.intro:
U ntse u tseba Mastermind.
U hloka ho fumana codi e le {code_length} digits kae, each digit ho tsoa 1 ho ea {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Ka karabo ya hao, u ka kenya tšehetso ya hao kateng '[2 1 4 5]'.
Kamora each guess, u tla fumana tokolla ka moka wa peg(e) e nyenyane le e tshweu.
Peg(e) e nyenyane e bontsha digit e latelang kateng le sebaka sa eona, ha peg(e) e tshweu e bontsha digit e latelang haholo, empa ha sebaka sa eona.
U na le {max_turns} matšoao a ho kenya codi.
player_prompt.with_repeats: ka ho pheta-pheta ha eona hoa khoneha

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ha ua ka oa arabela ka lenane la linomoro tse arohaneng ke likheo le kenngoeng har'a li-bracket.
invalid_move.not_integers: Litlaleho tsohle e lokela ho ba linomoro tse feletseng.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Ho hakanya ho lokela hore e be le linomoro tse {code_length} hantle.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Linomoro tsohle li tlameha ho ba pakeng tsa 1 le {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Linomoro tse kopitsoang ha lia lumelloa.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: U se u ntse u nahanne {guess}. Ka kōpo leka ho nahana ka tsela e fapaneng.

game_action.feedback: E rometsoe [{guess}]. Maikutlo: {black_pegs} pega e ntsho, {white_pegs} pega e tšoeu.

outcome.win: U ile wa qhekeha codi, u solofetse {black_pegs} ho tsoa {code_length} pegs ka molato
outcome.turn_limit: U khethile hantle karolo ea {percent} lekholong ea linomoro.
